goal: Replace the wallet's two loosely-synchronized transaction containers (mapWallet and wtxOrdered) with a single boost multi_index container.
Removes the raw-pointer indirection and manual bookkeeping needed to keep the two containers consistent.
reviewability: Ready to review. Author has addressed all reviewer nits and pushed follow-up commits resolving them, no open material questions.

result.summary: This PR replaces the wallet's two separate transaction containers, mapWallet (keyed by txid) and wtxOrdered (a secondary index of raw pointers keyed by insertion order), with a single boost::multi_index_container indexed by both txid and order position. All call sites across wallet.cpp, RPC, interfaces, tests, and fuzz harnesses are updated to use the new container via GetWalletTx, AddToWallet, m_txs_by_txid, and m_txs_by_pos. The change also makes CWalletTx::MarkDirty const to support extract/insert semantics instead of in-place pointer mutation.
result.problem: Maintaining two hand-synchronized containers (a map and a pointer-based ordering multimap) creates a burden and a latent correctness hazard: nothing enforces that wtxOrdered stays consistent with mapWallet when nOrderPos changes. Wallet maintainers feel this complexity whenever they touch transaction storage or ordering logic.

categories.rationale: P2 because this is a durable internal-structure improvement that removes a real synchronization hazard between two containers, and reviewer pablomartin4btc found and demonstrated a genuine latent bug ('ReorderTransactions() mutates nOrderPos in place but never touches wtxOrdered... a legacy wallet needing reorder can return transactions in the wrong order') that this refactor makes 'structurally impossible'. It also reduces future maintenance burden and is explicitly welcomed by theuni as compatible with planned kernel-decoupling work, giving it leverage for future wallet/kernel separation efforts, though it is not itself a user-facing feature or urgent fix.

uncertainties: Whether the fixed latent ordering bug (found by pablomartin4btc) has ever actually manifested for real users is unclear; it's described as narrow but real.

No explicit external blocking dependency was stated, though many open PRs conflict with this one (11 listed), meaning its merge will require rebase work across the wallet area regardless of its own priority.
result.card: This PR replaces bitcoind wallet's mapWallet and wtxOrdered containers with a single boost::multi_index_container indexed by txid and by insertion position, removing the raw-pointer indirection and manual synchronization between the two structures. The problem is a maintenance and correctness hazard: reviewer pablomartin4btc discovered that the refactor incidentally fixes a real latent bug where legacy wallets with nOrderPos == -1 could return transactions in the wrong order from listtransactions, because wtxOrdered was never updated by ReorderTransactions(); the new structure makes this class of bug structurally impossible since nOrderPos is the sort key itself. Maintainer theuni gave a substantive Concept ACK, requested explicit per-index access and extract/insert semantics instead of implicit-index and modify, and the author implemented all of it across several force-pushes; two more reviewers (pablomartin4btc, rkrux) also gave positive reviews with no unresolved objections. The PR conflicts with eleven other open wallet PRs, meaning it will require coordination on merge order, but has no stated hard dependency itself. Review state is Ready, with only a trivial doc-wording nit outstanding as of the 2026-09-14 push.
